title: Templates Management on /ops/cms: releases fold into templates like the customer card, one header press per template state with per-CMS presses on the listing strip, and Save listing never publishes
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/web/tracy-harness/test/template-fold.test.mjs packages/web/tracy-harness/test/template-presses.test.mjs packages/web/tracy-harness/test/card-save-publish.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts.
expect: The run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

template-fold: a release on a shown card belongs to that card's template; tracy-base/wp7 folds into Tracy Base, tracy-apple/j6 is its own template; two releases of one CMS in a template carry their tag on the chip.

template-presses: a Published template shows only Unpublish in the header, a Disabled one only Publish (off with 'Fix N issues first.' while issues remain); the listing strip shows Unpublish <CMS> when Listed, Publish <CMS> when Hidden (off with the reason the publish door would give), and an off Publish <CMS> with 'Save a listing first' when Not listed; design packs show no press.

card-save-publish: Save listing calls PUT /api/ops/quickstart/inspiration only, Publish calls POST /api/ops/quickstart/inspiration/publish, and a refused press prints the server text for that release.
evidence: 10/10/2026: one Templates Management screen replaces Quickstarts and Design inspiration; saving a card used to publish it.
fence: Pure client models and press logic with the doors doubled. Not exercised: the real GitHub release writes, demo capture, the rendered page.
